{{Quote|Have a good death. My mother was right about you.|Marlena Venn to Tanis Venn in a message inside his K-X12 probe droids|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Marlena Venn's mother''' birthed a daughter named [[Marlena Venn|Marlena]] who married [[Tanis Venn]] against [[Gender/Legends|her]] mother's warnings. Marlena later programed Tanis's [[K-X12 probe droid]]s to surround him and explode if he got too close. Marlena left a message mentioning her mother inside the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
